regions.breakdown: あぶない (abunai) is an i-adjective meaning 'dangerous'. The exclamation marks emphasize urgency.

where_youd_see_it: On a train platform or near train tracks to warn passengers of danger.
cultural_note: This style of cartoonish warning sign is common in Japan, particularly in public transit areas, designed to be highly visible and convey a quick, impactful message. They often use bold colors and dramatic imagery.
